name: install and load rstan package reliably
definition: Set up RStan in an R environment and import/verify it so sampling APIs are callable.
failure_mode: package load fails, later sampling and parse checks error out

name: interrogate a black-box relu mlp forward function
definition: import and call the provided scalar model wrapper across a deliberately chosen set of inputs to observe outputs for the recovery procedure.
failure_mode: shape or dtype issues when feeding inputs cause the querying step to error out before recovery
